name: Sugar Creek Dental Associates/Dr. Mark A. Littman
reviewSnippets: Dr Littman and Leslie are awesome! Not only are they VERY capable in all aspects of dentistry, they're really nice people to interact with! I came in for two crowns and they took care of me and made me feel like I was their only patient. …

Great Dentist. One of the few that still exist that will try his best to minimize cost while saving your smile... ( and there are many that are all about the $$) He is not...Everything does not turn into a root canal or financial plan when you visit.. I have gone in expecting such only to leave with good advise and some filing..
